{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Number of loyal, completed, non-QA orders: {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
